title: 05  剪映特效与转场操作.mp4
origin: User-provided local Jianying tutorial; abstracted principles, not a bundled preset.

route_semantics.typed: Supported technique.2.0 fields; build and validate an explicit graph.
route_semantics.recipe: Executable builder producing a typed graph.
route_semantics.workflow: Existing main workflow; separate confirmation and evidence remain required.

route_semantics.knowledge: Planning abstraction only; no new automatic detector or segmentation implementation.

techniques.name: 独立特效轨与叠加
techniques.intent: 在指定区间使用一个或多个可复用效果。

operations: active effects are applied/composited in specified order
duplicate span retains interval; split duplicates configuration into two adjoining spans

parameters.blur_example: Gaussian blur approximation: sigma_total=sqrt(sum(sigma_i^2)) if independent Gaussian passes

code_expression.timing: effect only active inside its interval; copied span starts at playhead in demonstrated UI

pitfalls: 并非所有特效重复两次都会单调增强，非线性/取反效果可能抵消；必须看结果。
仅写效果名称不执行；橙色负片、樱花等需实际资源或明确近似。
validation: 单轨/双轨对比，检查效果时间边界、顺序与画质；资源存在且可加载。

techniques.name: 边界转场
techniques.intent: 把相邻镜头的过渡建模为边界上的双输入操作。

operations: apply_all creates explicit transition objects for each eligible boundary

parameters.type: observed dissolve/叠化; other preset internals require asset
parameters.duration: adjustable seconds; no numeric default verified
parameters.handle_policy: explicitly choose overlap/source handles; do not infer timeline shortening from UI

code_expression.timing: transition interval centered or otherwise anchored to chosen boundary by backend contract

pitfalls: 必须保证两端有足够可用帧并显式定义重叠/延长策略。
UI未显示转场框不等于转场被删除。
统一应用不意味着每个转场都适合故事。
validation: 逐段检查边界首/中/尾帧，时长和源取帧合法，移除转场后硬切恢复。

unknowns: 完整ASR已读，未听审；特效滤镜的内部算法及资源版本未验证。
转场时长数值、源句柄/时间线重叠的精确旧版实现未从本课细节确认。
